modules.module_title: Identify, handle and store materials and painting tools and equipment

pcs.pc_description: receive work instructions and follow the same
identify and select paint material and tools and equipment for the job
ensure that the materials conform to the specified requirements of colour and quantity
sort materials by type and size and stack for ease of identification and retrieval
protect materials, tools and equipment from physical and water damage
store and handle tools and equipment safely
deliver materials, tools and equipment safely, to the work site from the storage area
prepare the work surface by removing objects, masking and using drop cloths to protect surrounding surfaces
prepare the surface in accordance with the manufacturer's recommendations and instructions of the painter/ supervisor
mix the materials in the recommended ratio and painter/ supervisor's instructions, to achieve the desired consistency and drying
stir the paint and colours thoroughly using separate stirring sticks or other devices
set up the application system in accordance with the instructions of the painter/ supervisor

modules.module_title: Clean the work area after painting

pcs.pc_description: dispose off waste and discarded materials into appropriate waste bins or rubbish stock pile
clean the tools and equipment with appropriate solvents
dispose off paint waste, water and solvents used in cleaning the painting equipment, as per organization's and local disposal norms
store tools, equipment and unused materials safely
